items.raw_summary: Gorkha Brewery, part of the Carlsberg Group, has appointed Arvind Katariya as Marketing Director, marking his move into a leadership role at the company's India business.Katariya confirmed the appointment in a LinkedIn post. He brings more than 19 years of experience in marketing and brand leadership across fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) categories, including home care, hair oils and oral care.Prior to the new appointment, he served as General Manager – Marketing at Carlsberg India, where he was responsible for leading brands and marketing initiatives. His experience includes managing multiple portfolios with full profit and loss (P&L) ownership, overseeing brand strategy, innovation and communications across consumer segments.Katariya began his career in sales, managing territories across Gujarat and Chhattisgarh. He credits this experience with shaping his understanding of market dynamics, consumer insights and execution.His areas of expertise include strategic brand building, integrated marketing communications, category growth, innovation strategy and cross-functional team leadership.

items.title: China's Zhejiang flags IP risks in commercial use of open-source AI models - MLex
items.raw_summary: Businesses using open-source artificial intelligence models commercially face intellectual property risks that model licenses alone cannot resolve, new guidelines from China’s Zhejiang province warn, urging checks on underlying technology, training data and branding.
items.title_pt: China's Zhejiang flags IP risks in commercial use of open-source AI models - MLex
items.summary_pt: Alertas sobre riscos de propriedade intelectual ao usar modelos de IA abertos comercialmente em branding.
items.pme_pt: Orienta o pequeno/médio empresário que usa IA em branding a pensar em riscos legais e de marca — essencial para não prejudicar posicionamento futuro.
